scope: Authorized future product actions in an isolated synthetic collection, never source imports. No active user stores or Memory Center 61563.

actions.when: after initial maintenance settles, before T1
actions.targetSelection: Resolve the actual canonical lease/capacity article from runtime evidence and record its page ID, generated base and edit version externally; no canned title.
changes: Deliberately edit and protect the title.
Add and protect a personal synthetic review annotation.
verification: Human author identity and protection are retained.
Subsequent agent text is not mislabeled human-authored.
actions.recovery: Use only the disposable evaluation collection; preserve conflict evidence outside imports.

actions.precondition: protect-lease accepted with actual captured edit version
actions.proposal: Submit one genuine maintenance proposal overlapping the protected annotation or title, while allowing the unprotected command correction and unrelated targets to proceed.
verification: Specific recoverable conflict rather than overwrite.
Unrelated target progress is observed, not inferred.
No blanket family approval or halt.
actions.recovery: Keep the conflict unresolved for measurement; any user resolution is separately counted.

runtimeProcedure: Map the fixture key to its actual product sourceId and activeRevisionId in the isolated collection.
Before forgetting, record actual derived IDs and read-but-not-cited influence; protect one dependent annotation and hold one in-flight result that read the source.
Use previewForgetSource on the actual source and obtain the product confirmationToken through the authorized evaluation flow.
Call forgetSource with corpusId, actual sourceId and confirmationToken. Tokens are runtime-only and never placed in this fixture.
Release the held result only after durable removal denial; inspect rejection and recovery of dependent artifacts.
Verify all retained source revisions absent, active count 24, and source/index/synopsis/topic/view/history/context no longer reveal the routing convention.
verification: No late result, undo or historical redirect resurrects removed content.
Actual product receipts distinguish denial, purge enrollment and completed purge.
actions.recovery: Resume source-owned purge recovery after interruption; never restore forgotten evidence from a historical view.

actions.when: at a runtime-selected accepted T1 or T2 canonical commit, before index/acknowledgement
runtimeProcedure: Capture actual job, target, commit and derivative-index state externally.
Interrupt only the explicitly owned disposable evaluator process at the stated post-commit boundary.
Restart through the product's normal recovery path and observe index repair without duplicating accepted content.
Repeat maintenance unchanged after eligible discovery settles, recording actual synthesis calls and content revision counts.
verification: Zero synthesis calls on settled unchanged repeat.
Unsettled work remains visible and independent targets continue.
actions.recovery: Keep durable accepted effects; repair derivatives rather than regenerating accepted content.
